data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

data.l1_hook: Regarde dehors ! Prends un parapluie ! "raining cats and dogs"
data.l1_ex: Il pleut « raining cats and dogs »!

native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = pleuvoir à seaux. Exemple: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
native.caption:
